summary.en: A request types; its caret runs to the seam’s place and stands up into it; the first result slides out of the seam; the claim rises in two phrases.
summary.zh: 一行请求打出来；光标跑到接缝的位置立起来变成接缝；第一个结果从接缝里滑出；主张分两段升起。

fits: The opening of a film about input and output.
notFor: A film that does not start from something typed.

intent.en: The edit point becomes the boundary: what is typed opens onto what it makes.
intent.zh: 编辑点变成边界：打下的字通向它做出的东西。

content.en: A request (≤ 40 characters, as the product reads it), a first result, a claim in 1–2 phrases (≤ 5 words each).
content.zh: 一行请求（≤ 40 字符，产品实际读的写法）、第一个结果、1–2 段主张（每段 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 讲输入与输出的片子的开场。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
